title: VelithCraft
description: A modified multilingual server with translated chat and interface, focused on RPGs and saving the world from the undead
body:
A modified multilingual server with translated chat and interface, focused on RPGs and saving the world from the undead, yet allowing everyone to find their niche. 

There are custom: 
- items
- mobs
- bosses
- buildings
- biomes

Interesting mechanics, pets, mounts, jobs, fishing and more..
